sources.label: Wikipedia, "8 Draconis"
sources.quote: 8 Draconis, formally named Taiyi, is a single star in the northern circumpolar constellation of Draco.

introduction.text: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 1.6 solar radii and 1.48 solar masses (FLAME) and 7,094 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).

sources.quote: Based upon an annual parallax shift of 33.97 mas as seen from the Earth, the star is located 96 light-years from the Sun.
